summary: Magnum Ice Cream Co N.V. filed a Form 6-K containing a Q1 2026 trading update. The report discloses revenue of €1.770bn, organic sales growth of 4.5%, and reaffirms full-year guidance. It notes completed acquisitions of India and Portugal in March/April 2026, but no deal terms are provided. This is a routine quarterly operational update, not a special-situation event, so no transaction details, board recommendations, or risk-arb angles apply.
